pinev: Moved 30 Oct 2026 to the Wallace School corner (GNIS Wallace School 44.40996,-90.21847, County Hwy E at Wallace Rd). The Oct 1929 'West Veedum' news column has the West Veedum 4-H meeting at the Wallace school, with the Wallace, E. M. Hayes, William Kurtz and Edd Macha families. The hotel, hall and store sites are not placed, so this is good to about 1.5 km
No railroad shows within 2.5 km on the 1938 air photos (Wood BIL 1-90, 2-26); the 1929 fire report's track is unexplained. Unconfirmed, one source

cd-west-veedum-1929-fire.st: Placement: the West Veedum news column (Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune, 10 Oct 1929, p. 4) has the West Veedum 4-H meeting at the Wallace school and names the Wallace, E. M. Hayes, William Kurtz and Edd Macha families. So the pin was moved to the Wallace School corner on County Hwy E, about 3 km west of Veedum station. The nearest railroad on the 1938 photos is the North Western diagonal, about 2.8 km northeast, so the track in the fire report is still unexplained.
src: Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune, 10 Oct 1929, p. 4, West Veedum column (newspapers.com image 243423396, PC thread sweep)
